Donald Trump’s midterm defeat could change American politics, but what does it mean for his presidency and India?
In this video, we explain how US midterm elections work, why they matter to Trump, and how losing control of Congress could limit his powers. We also explore the impact on India-US relations, tariffs, Indian-American voters, and America's foreign policy.
Will Trump's defeat benefit India, or bring more uncertainty to global geopolitics?
Watch till the end to find out.
A video by Abhiraj Rajadhyaksha & Niyati Mavinkurve
